## Findings

### F-bd211065: BD 211065 is brain-heart infusion agar, but its MIM owner maps to heart infusion agar

major / open / confirmed; issue key: worker03-bd211065.

ATCC44 and official BD catalog identify211065 as BBL Brain Heart Infusion Agar. Current MIM Heart_Infusion_Agar_BD_211065 instead targets MICRO0000567 heart infusion agar and carries heart-only Difco/Eiken aliases. OLS defines that target as heart infusion plus tryptose, a different formulation. Propose a catalog-specific BBL identity with an explicit competing-owner reconciliation blocker.

### F-molasses: Sugar beet molasses maps to sugar beet root despite an exact molasses term

major / open / confirmed; issue key: worker03-molasses.

The current FOODON00003412 term is sugar-beet root, while the material is molasses, a sugar-refining syrup. Exact FOODON03543005 explicitly includes molasses obtained from sugar beet and is nonobsolete in the retrieved ontology. Propose that exact material concept and canonical label, preserving original history and the WITHHOLD release obligation until the changed complete payload is independently reviewed.

### F-phb: Reconcile PHB polymer identities without merging R-specific and unspecified polymers

major / open / confirmed; issue key: worker03-phb.

MediaDive300 explicitly gives Poly[(R)-3-hydroxybutyric acid] and SIGMA. Primary Sigma363502 and exact ChEBI:131525 support R-specific PHB. Current CAS29435-48-1 owner erroneously maps to monomer and carries finite-trimer chemistry.

### F-citrate: Citric acid monohydrate retains resolving citrate(1-) aliases

major / open / confirmed; issue key: worker03-citrate.

TOGO M2231 defines citric acid monohydrate4.8g plus deionized water input1L as a stock, solute CHEBI:31404. MediaDive786 links DSMZ848 RAE medium; its original PDF p1 row4 explicitly lists citric acid xH2O1.50g, matching the frozen source. Exact ChEBI:31404 matches monohydrate; citrate(1-) aliases in the owner denote a different charge state.

### F-nh4-s4: Ammonium sulfate incorrectly resolves the source formula (NH4)2S4 as an exact synonym

major / open / confirmed; issue key: worker03-nh4-s4.

The admitted MediaDive1902 raw record literally says(NH4)2S4, not(NH4)2SO4. ChEBI:62946 ammonium sulfate requires four oxygens; restoring oxygen would change chemistry and is not justified by the near name.

## Limits And Additional Notes

- This is a compilation of source mapping assessments and their independent reviews, not an independent final owner release assessment.
- needs_curation records proposed changes and unresolved source-specific evidence requirements; no inherited WITHHOLD or REJECTED obligation is cleared.
- Frozen source-root captures remain referenced by exact hash in the campaign evidence contract and validated by its whole-shard auditor. Native source inspection additionally binds actual owner bytes and local campaign/primary captures.
- No maintained ingredient, aggregate, SSSOM, unified mapping, semantic selector or downstream KG product was changed. Integration and full native exports belong to the coordinator.
